brands.name: default
brands.label: Default
brands.description: The default brand: crisp, confident and light-first. Cool grays with one cobalt accent, Bricolage Grotesque for display type and labels (slightly condensed, with ink traps that show at slide sizes, set with open tracking so letters never touch) over Inter for reading, a dusk gradient from cobalt into ink, soft medium radii and quick, quiet motion. The logo sits top right, so nothing in the margin stacks on a footnote.

brands.name: nocturne
brands.label: Nocturne
brands.description: Nocturne: dark-first and editorial. Violet-black night, a warm ember accent, a soft optical serif for display type with mono labels, a grainy aurora gradient, sharp corners and slow, cinematic motion. It contrasts with the default brand on every axis.

brands.name: fieldnote
brands.label: Fieldnote
brands.description: Fieldnote: warm, printed and editorial, for research findings, reports and talks that should feel considered rather than corporate. Cream paper and a warm near-black ink, forest green with terracotta and ochre, Playfair Display for headings over Source Sans 3 for reading, small radii, soft warm shadows and an unhurried fade. Its title slides sit on deep forest with a botanical sprig drawn in paper ink; a `notebook` surface rules the slide like a field notebook.

brands.name: kinetic
brands.label: Kinetic
brands.description: Kinetic: loud, fast and engineered, for product launches, developer talks and demo days. Chalk white and ink black with an electric blue and an acid lime, Space Grotesk set tight and heavy for headings over Inter Tight, mono labels, square corners, hard offset shadows instead of soft ones, and a quick push between slides. Its title slides glow blue and pink under a line grid; the `grid` surface puts a dot grid under content, and section slides carry a giant chevron.

brands.name: tidewater
brands.label: Tidewater
brands.description: Tidewater: calm, clear and trustworthy, for climate, health, public-sector and finance decks that carry numbers people act on. Warm sand under deep sea blues, a coral accent used sparingly, one family (Hanken Grotesk) from light statistics to semibold headings, generous rounded corners, soft long shadows and a slow fade. Title slides sit on a deep tide gradient under topographic contour lines; the `shore` surface brings faint contours to light content slides.
